name: setActive
description: Pin the active provider/model selection. Goes through LlmBroker::DispatchUserPick which (a) writes the active selection to prefs and (b) pushes a `session.applySelection` event to the live nexus_web SharedWorker so the in-flight session rebinds without a reload. Replaced the legacy chrome.send `pickNexusSelection` route of the retired WebUI quick-settings popup. Exposed on the panel WebUI bridge port only. No secret in payload or response.

inputs.name: selection
inputs.description: { providerId: string, modelId: string, thinkingTier?: string }. The thinkingTier carries provider-specific routing hints (anthropic's extended-thinking budget, etc.); empty/absent means default.
